messages.subject: Project Drake — due diligence enquiries (round 2)
messages.plaintextBody:
Deepa,

Following our review of the data room, our second-round enquiries are attached in the usual schedule. The priorities are: (1) the Port Solent lease and confirmation that landlord's consent to change of control under clause 4.12 can be obtained; (2) the Phase I environmental report and the status of the Phase II investigation at Hamble; and (3) the Solent Marine Fuels supply agreement and its change-of-control clause. These will feed the disclosure letter.

Elena

messages.subject: RE: Project Drake — due diligence enquiries (round 2)
messages.plaintextBody:
Elena,

Replies uploaded to the data room. In short: (1) the landlord has indicated consent will be forthcoming and we've applied formally; (2) Phase I is in the room, Phase II is underway with results expected late November; (3) the fuel supplier has confirmed informally it won't exercise its change-of-control right, written confirmation to follow. Let me know if you need anything further for the disclosure exercise.

Deepa
